about: Hand-curated venue research for TLVFest, keyed by the code the shared Cinematheque adapter gives the Tel Aviv Cinematheque. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

tel-aviv-cinematheque.name: סינמטק תל אביב

coordinates.basis: approximate: the article's coordinates, given to the nearest second of arc

tel-aviv-cinematheque.notes: Every screening's card names its hall, numbered 1 to 5; no seat count per hall is published on the programme.
